title: DiagnosticEventAvailableCaller
source_docs: AUTOSAR Blockset/Classic Platform/Basic Software/Diagnostic Event Manager (Dem)/DiagnosticEventAvailableCaller.md
text: Call AUTOSAR Diagnostic Event Manager (Dem) service interface EventAvailable; {Client port name} sets the name of client port AUTOSAR component uses to call Dem service interface, {Operation} sets the operation defined in Dem service interface EventAvailable and {Sample time} sets the block sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Client port name
params.values: Name of client port AUTOSAR component uses to call Dem service interface EventAvailable EventAvailable (default) | character vector

params.name: Operation
params.values: Specify operation defined in Dem service interface EventAvailable SetEventAvailable (default)
